facts.fact: Bill No. 39 of 27 March 2024, from the Minister for Internal Affairs, would amend the Registration of Persons Act 2015 to transfer administration of the civil registration laws (Children Act, marriage Acts) to the National Identification and Registration Authority, so that civil registration sits in that one agency.

UGA.note: The bill moves administrative responsibility for civil registration laws and says nothing on a digital register.

facts.fact: Bill No. 39 of 2024 proposes to amend section 5 of the Registration of Persons Act 2015 (Act 4 of 2015), the existing law setting out the functions of the National Identification and Registration Authority.

UGA.note: Nothing on a number given at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
Nothing on registers keyed on the ID number.
Nothing on the ID system's issuance, biometrics or certification.
Nothing on local government offices' connection.
Nothing on local civil registration offices entering events digitally.
